title: Animations without prefers-reduced-motion
user_impact: Users with vestibular disorders or photosensitivity cannot disable motion.
source: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions (Level AAA); Media Queries 5 'prefers-reduced-motion'
applicability: Style rules outside a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce block that animate or transition a motion property (transform, translate, rotate, scale, position offsets, ...) on a selector matching an element of the page.
expectation:
One page-level review when at least one such rule is not switched off under
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce). Switched off means animation: none,
a duration of at most about 50 ms (the usual 0.01ms reset), paused, or
transition: none / transition-property: none, set for the same selector or
by a universal reset. A reduce block that only shortens the movement (0.2s)
does not switch it off. Colour and opacity fades are not motion. Rules whose
selector matches nothing on the page are not evidence. Review, not a
violation: whether the motion is triggered by interaction and is essential is
a human decision.
